test_comment_inline: test read_csv with comment='#' strips inline comments from CSV data
test_comment_line_comments: test read_csv with comment='#' skips full-line comments before and between data rows
test_comment_with_skiprows: test read_csv with comment='#' and skiprows=4 ignores comment lines before skipping
test_comment_with_header: test read_csv with comment='#' and header=1 finds header at second non-comment line
test_comment_with_skiprows_and_header: test read_csv with comment='#', skiprows=4, and header=1 combines both options
test_custom_comment_char: test read_csv with custom comment characters like ~, &, ^, *, @
test_comment_first_line: test read_csv with comment='#' when comment appears on the first line before header
test_comment_char_in_na_values: test read_csv with comment='#' and na_values='#N/A' handles comment char in NA values
